hints.title: Sequential Traversal
hints.text: Start at the head pointer and traverse forward following next pointers until encountering null.

hints.title: Value Extraction
hints.text: Append current node value to the result list on each step.

hints.title: Termination Condition
hints.text: Return the accumulated list when the forward pointer reaches null.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
# Definition for a Node.
# class Node:
#     def __init__(self, val, prev=None, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.prev = prev
#         self.next = next

class Solution:
    def toArray(self, head: 'Optional[Node]') -> list[int]:
        res = []
        curr = head
        while curr:
            res.append(curr.val)
            curr = curr.next
        return res
```

variables: n: number of nodes in the doubly linked list
complexity.notes: Single pass visiting every node once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing backwards or checking prev links is redundant when traversing forward from head.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Standard pointer iteration through a linked data structure.
